top_signals.title: Anduril reveals family of surface-to-air interceptor missiles
top_signals.summary: The interceptor family was built to address threats across the air-and-missile defense spectrum, while aiming to come at a fraction of the cost of others.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Walmart to cover some GLP-1s, inhalers and insulin for employees at no cost as it expands benefits
top_signals.summary: Walmart will offer Novo's Ozempic and Lilly's Mounjaro without charge for people with Type 2 diabetes after a new prior authorization.
